messages:
Alex P: Heads up — FinBank wants a 6-week POC combining Hosted API (chat), Optimize evals, and Console 90d retention + audit log export. They also asked for SOC2 + ISO attestation. Target start 2026-03-01.

Priya - AE: Enterprise account, likely convert to 24mo commit if latency & cost OK. Proposed commit ~$420k ARR. POC asks: 1M token cap, 2k Optimize credits, audit log export, SAML, VPC peering. Will need Dedicated for stable tail latency.

Marco - SE: For meaningful tests we need Dedicated 4x GPUs (or equiv fractional), KMS access, VPC peering, and IP allowlist. We'll run both low-latency chat and batch reranking profiles. Need ETA on infra provisioning.

Jules - Sales Ops: Ratecard notes: Optimize credits at $0.45/credit, Console 60d incremental retention $1,200/mo, Audit log export SKU = EXPORT_LOGS. Dedicated overlay priced per-card/month. Need SKU lines and GL mapping to issue a single POC invoice.

Leah - Deal Desk: At $420k ARR, standard cross-product discount band is ~10-12%. What discount are we requesting? Any one-time concessions?

Priya - AE: They're asking for 15% cross-product/commit discount + $25k one-time POC credit to cover implementation risk. Also requesting 30% off dev/support hours for setup.

Leah - Deal Desk: 15% is out of standard band. We can approve up to 12% with DD exec sign-off. $25k one-time credit requires CFO sign-off because of revenue recognition. Dev-support discount needs Services/RevOps approval.

Marco - SE: Can we reframe $25k as a marketing co-fund contingent on a case study + webinar? That usually reduces formal approvals.

Noah - Marketing: We can commit up to $15k marketing co-fund if they sign within 60 days and agree to a case study + promo webinar. No guarantee beyond that.

Leah - Deal Desk: Approval paths: Option A = 12% recurring discount + $15k marketing co-fund (Deal Desk exec sign-off). Option B = 13-15% recurring + $25k one-time credit requires Head of Sales + CFO + Legal approvals and GAAP review. Which path do we prefer?

Priya - AE: Recommend Option A to avoid escalation and keep timeline. Ask for 12% recurring + $10k dev-support waived + $15k marketing credit. That keeps approvals quick.

Jules - Sales Ops: Draft POC invoice estimate (6-week pro rata):
- API hosted cap: $10,000
- Dedicated overlay (6 weeks pro rata): $8,000
- Optimize credits (2,000 * $0.45): $900
- Console 90d retention incremental (pro rata): $1,800
- Audit log export SKU: $2,000
- Eng/setup support: $6,000
Total POC invoice: $28,700 (one-time)
Proposed conversion: 24mo @ $420,000 ARR, proposed recurring discount: 12%

Jules - Sales Ops: Please map GL codes: API_USAGE, DEDICATED_OVERLAY, OPTIMIZE_CRED, CONSOLE_RETENTION, EXPORT_LOGS, ENG_SUPPORT. Finance needs this before we issue invoice.

security-bot: Uploaded: FinBank_DPA.docx, SOC2_ISO_bundle.pdf, NetworkDiagram_FinBank.png to https://redwood.internal/security/finbank. Also attached SOC2 attestation snippet.

Leah - Deal Desk: Provisionally approved Option A. Legal to review DPA and audit log export T&Cs. Finance to confirm GL mapping. Note: any guaranteed burst SLA will trigger higher approval risk and may convert some concessions into a managed services retainer.

Priya - AE: I'll update SFDC with fields: POC_invoice_amount = 28700; Proposed_ARR = 420000; Proposed_discount = 12%; Approval_status = Provisionally Approved. Attaching security docs now.

Alex P: :thumbsup: No objections from me.

Marco - SE: :thumbsup: We'll queue infra provisioning once provisionally approved and SFDC fields are set.

Noah - Marketing: :thumbsup: We'll prepare case study templates; legal sign-off on co-marketing needed.

Leah - Deal Desk: I'll add DD exec sign-off after SFDC shows attachments and GL codes. If Legal flags audit export or burst SLA, we may need to revisit the one-time dev concession.

Priya - AE: Thanks team — updating SFDC and will ping when done. Will post infra kickoff in this thread.
